task_description: Build a production-ready single-page Next.js dashboard for NFL receiver Target Over Expectation (TOE) analytics for broadcasters: a hero scatter, two leaderboards, 32 team-tendency panels, a Sankey ball-flow, a coverage profile, a sticky live-broadcast filter bar, and a Story Mode toggle. All data in a standalone, swappable public/data/receivers.json produced by a committed generator script. Must pass npm install and npm run build with no errors.
